policy: Do not vendor complete third-party engines, install unused runtime packages, or ship unreviewed assets. Tools are GitHub-linked choices; only explicitly integrated artifacts have repo paths.

records.name: Tiled Map Editor
records.purpose: Edit master tilemaps, tile layers, collision and marker objects.
records.note: Tiled executable is not embedded or distributed; GPL on editor doesn't make YZ Farm Life GPL.

records.name: LDtk
records.purpose: Alternative entity-based 2D level editor; do not run two incompatible map source formats.
records.note: Tiled is chosen as the initial single source format.

records.name: Tween.js
records.purpose: Easing for camera, dialogue panels and UI transitions.
records.note: Existing WalkPath/Footwork and CSS transitions take priority; install only with explicit measured need.

records.name: Howler.js
records.purpose: Layered ambience, SFX and cross-browser volume control.
records.note: FieldAudio already handles real ambience and sound on iOS; do not duplicate AudioContexts.

records.name: EasyStar.js
records.purpose: Optional A* pathfinding for larger collision grids.
records.note: Current BFS handles 24x16 Pasirluyu areas; benchmark before switching.

records.name: LibreSprite
records.purpose: Author/edit sprite sheets and walk animations locally.
records.note: Editor is separate from shipped game; game must only embed appropriately licensed sprite artwork.

records.name: Kenney Tiny Town
records.purpose: Reference compact town buildings, fences and signs.
records.note: Present before this task; 16x16 grid needs art style review before use.

records.name: Kenney RPG Urban Pack
records.purpose: Reference urban street and market props.

records.name: Kenney UI Pack - Pixel Adventure
records.purpose: 16 starter pixels for story panels and YZ Phone skin.
records.note: Selected 16 sprites copied from pinned mirror commit 3694c6879e487c108f55677be7dd2ca75b07cc3b. Not yet live in-game.

records.name: Free Game Dev Assets
records.purpose: Find CC0 sounds and props. Verify each upstream item's license.
records.note: Do not bulk-import catalog contents; licenses vary by item.
